Reachable only through Nuxt/Nitro dev tooling: nuxt -> @nuxt/nitro-server -> nitropack -> listhen -> node-forge. listhen imports node-forge at load time and uses it only to create a self-signed development HTTPS certificate when https is enabled without a supplied key and cert. listhen never calls signature verification, and the nitropack runtime and holo-js sources do not import listhen. Remove when listhen drops node-forge.
